description_zh: 查询单个自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs get-auto-snapshot-policy --policy-id sp-z5siir3iq3m0000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy
parameters.name: policy_id

Data.description_en: The details of the automatic snapshot policy

AppliedDbfsNumber.description_en: The number of DBFS instances to which this automatic snapshot policy is applied
AppliedDbfsNumber.description_zh: 设置该自动快照策略的数据库文件系统数量

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created

LastModified.description_en: The time when the policy was last modified

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy

RepeatWeekdays.description_en:
The days of the week on which to create automatic snapshots. Valid values: 1 to 7, where 1 indicates Monday. The parameter must be a JSON array. For example, \`\["1","3","5"]\` indicates that automatic snapshots are created on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

Input parameters must be in JSON array format. For example, ["1"] means to create automatic snapshots every Monday.

To create multiple automatic snapshots within a week, pass multiple time points. Separate them with a comma (,). Pass up to 7 time points. For example, ["1","3","5"] means to create automatic snapshots every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
RepeatWeekdays.description_zh:
自动快照的重复日期列表，单位为天，周期为星期。取值范围：1~7，例如1表示周一。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示每周一重复创建自动快照。

当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入7个时间点。例如，["1","3","5"]表示每周一、周三、周五重复创建自动快照

items.description_en: The day of the week on which an automatic snapshot is created
items.description_zh: 自动快照的重复日期，周期为星期

RetentionDays.description_en: The retention period of snapshots, in days. Valid values: 1 to 65535. A value of -1 indicates continuous retention. Snapshots are automatically deleted when the number of snapshots reaches the upper limit
RetentionDays.description_zh: 快照保留天数（1-65535，-1为持续保留，直至快照数量达到额度上限后被自动删除）
RetentionDays.title_en: 快照保留天数（1-65535，NULL为永久保存）
RetentionDays.title_zh: 快照保留天数（1-65535，NULL为永久保存）

StatusDetail.description_en: The details of an abnormal status. This parameter is empty if the value of \`Status\` is \`Normal\`
StatusDetail.description_zh: 若出现异常的状态信息详情，status为normal时为空

TimePoints.description_en:
The points in time of a day at which to create automatic snapshots. The time is in UTC+8. The parameter must be a JSON array. The values must be from 0 to 23. For example, \`\["01","03","15"]\` indicates that automatic snapshots are created at 01:00, 03:00, and 15:00.

Pass the parameter as a JSON array. For example, ["1"] creates an automatic snapshot at 01:00.

To create multiple automatic snapshots in one day, pass multiple time points separated by commas. You can pass up to 24 time points. For example, ["01","03","15"] creates automatic snapshots at 01:00, 03:00, and 15:00
TimePoints.description_zh:
自动快照的创建时间点列表。使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如01表示01:00。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示01:00创建自动快照。

当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入24个时间点。例如，["01","03","15"]表示01:00、03:00、15:00时创建自动快照

items.description_en: The point in time of a day at which to create an automatic snapshot
items.description_zh: 自动快照的创建时间点
